reviewType: Independent read-only remediation design consultation; not implementation review or final QA gate
approvalScope: Approve the R1 architecture for implementation with the mandatory conditions below. The original independent FAIL remains authoritative until the separate QA reviewer re-runs the implemented fixes. This record does not certify current code fixed or authorize broader scope.
summary: The closed disputed-use meaning and durable bootstrap stages fit existing immutable JSON/progress storage and existing authenticated worker/context seams. No V32 migration or runner change is intrinsically required. Approval depends on enforcing exact use, one-time READY semantics and committed accounting refusal, rather than treating a stored plan, an included reference or HTTP success as execution authority.

mandatoryConditions.condition: Use a closed {need:{stepId,occurrence,operationKind,argumentSlot},reference}. Require every alternative to have the exact same need. Resolve step membership from the frozen source, bound occurrence by the frozen statement limit, restrict operationKind to operations with a source-input slot and require argumentSlot to equal the trusted operation-to-slot mapping. Validate each reference against the immutable source/configuration and that same step/slot. A later step/occurrence can be a semantic question before materialization; it does not move stepIndex, fabricate observed evidence or allocate an obligation/input/admission. No English regex parser is needed or justified.

At initial plan admission, replan and every action admission, enforce every accepted source selection against exactly one obligation at its stepId+occurrence: same operation/slot, non-null referenceIndex, null runtime needId, and exact canonical chosen reference at that index. Including the selected reference unused, using another alternative, moving it to another occurrence or substituting a binding is invalid. Preserve the server obligation ID and exact reference-to-materialized-input provenance after admission. Key second-question/redefinition checks by the disputed coordinate within immutable session/source, not the complete need object: changing operationKind/slot must not create a new apparent need at the same coordinate. Other occurrences still require their own independent plan/action validation.

Keep the public answer DTO unchanged. Set source question.coordinate to need.stepId/occurrence; do not leave the current-step/zero default. Observed question coordinates likewise must identify their actual disputed admitted obligation. Source questions retain phase=source, documentId=null and generation=0 under PREPARING/no-actions guards. Persist alternatives and need atomically with the question and accept only the stored choice. Existing V32 identity/meanings JSON and single-assignment accepted_choice trigger support this without schema migration. Do not rewrite old immutable meanings into the new shape.

Update source question output schemas, sourceSelections extraction, planning-context clarificationSelections, compact provider schemas and output instructions together; the current selected.has(referenceKind) filter would otherwise silently discard the new envelope. Retain exact strict-schema/planning-context/provider/output hashes in the immutable manifest. Check these pins on bootstrap-only resumes and direct routes before materialization/context delivery, not only in call() before provider sends. Old-pin sessions refuse rather than silently interpreting old bare references as richer meanings.

mandatoryConditions.area: Atomic stage transitions and stable allocation
mandatoryConditions.condition: Keep PLAN_ACCEPTED/MATERIALIZED/ALLOCATED/CONTEXT_PENDING/READY inside session progress; existing continuation retains its SQL-allowed values. Accept plan plus PLAN_ACCEPTED/MATERIALIZE in the same transaction. Resume materialization with its exact existing key and immutable reference body, preserving original contextId/contextRevision/authoredInputsHash. Replay allocation using stable accepted need keys and exact need bodies; atomically persist binding IDs, accepted plan revision and ALLOCATED. Re-read current authoritative runnerContext after allocation rather than sending a stale cached materialize response without allocations. Persist CONTEXT_PENDING and the exact original materialization/plan/source/scope/owner/fence identity before network I/O.

The transition into READY/NEXT requires a committed owning-worker bootstrap evidence record, exact evidence hash, initialBlank generation0, matching original live materialization/context/source/scope/fence, all stable allocations, and no prior action admission. HTTP200 alone is insufficient. Tie readiness to the CONTEXT_PENDING snapshot. The existing bootstrap callback attests contextId/contextRevision, not materializationRevision or allocation payload: if initial evidence predates the pending allocation snapshot, require a successful same-context metadata delivery as well as that prior committed callback; do not infer that an old callback proved newly added allocations. No new callback schema is required.

mandatoryConditions.area: Actual scanner and direct route guards
mandatoryConditions.condition: continueRuns must route by durable bootstrap stage/continuation, never plan existence. Any non-READY accepted bootstrap is routed to plans even under a stale NEXT continuation. Direct proposals/context/replan entry points must refuse or complete the missing bootstrap before inference or action authority. READY is a one-time transition: already-READY repeated plans calls must return current safe state or a revision refusal, without re-freezing inputs, reallocating IDs, resetting continuation, requiring the current evidence still be initialBlank or rejecting merely because successful actions now exist. Preserve REFRESH, AWAITING_CLARIFICATION and recovery continuations.

mandatoryConditions.area: Context crash windows and real existing worker seam
mandatoryConditions.condition: Recover a lost initial context response from a matching committed callback and original materialization snapshot. If no matching callback exists, retry only the same context on the live assigned worker, retaining original assignment/fence/input identity and rechecking no prior effects. Existing ownership.context waits contextStart and updates an existing runtime; stopped/lost contexts fail closed and journal ownership prevents reconstruction. Repeated context updates do not emit another initial bootstrap callback. Therefore do not wait for a second callback from an already-live context, and never satisfy readiness by making a new worker/browser, inventing callback evidence or consuming a dispatch again. A post-effect missing context remains terminal.

Reconcile immutable late usage while holding the same session lock as every reservation and every committed send claim, including repairs and expired-attempt recovery. Return refusal decisions and commit counters/receipt markers/terminal state before throwing outward. Cover the less obvious case where the late delta is still under the total ceiling but makes the next reservation exceed remaining budget: the existing reserveModel/reserve require() throws inside a joined transaction and can roll back that reconciled delta. Preflight the combined reservation and persist stop/refusal, or otherwise guarantee the reconciliation remains committed on every such refusal. Guard old-pin/source/repair failures after reconciliation against unintended rollback. Terminal accounting may increase counters but never changes terminal lifecycle or creates send rights.

The committed send claim is the authorization linearization point; a receipt committed before it must block the send when the reconciled budget refuses. A later receipt cannot retroactively un-send an already claimed provider request, but must be charged before the next claim. No ambient/joined transaction may keep the session lock around provider or runner I/O; prove the concrete gateway/client invocation occurs after transaction completion, including repairs.

focusedRegressionExpectations: Both source destination choices exercised via public answer, then real navigation with independently checked selected/unselected endpoint receipts; schema-valid include-selected-but-use-rejected plan must fail before materialization/action.

A question for a later step and nonzero occurrence displays the correct public coordinate, keeps PREPARING/current step unchanged, and forces that exact use in the eventual plan; mixed needs and operation/slot/ordinal/step movement, unused chosen reference and repeated redefinition refuse.
Changed NEXT_ACTION authored input, runtime binding substitution and replan mutation fail despite strict-schema validity; the allowed chosen input still executes.

Manifest/provider/output/context pin changes reject an old accepted plan before bootstrap materialization/context delivery even without a new provider call; old immutable question JSON is never rewritten.

Actual continueRuns fault tests after plan acceptance, after committed materialization, after partial allocations, and after persisted NEXT/CONTEXT_PENDING before first context delivery. Expect one SOURCE_PLAN send, one immutable input table/context identity, stable binding IDs and no NEXT_ACTION send before authenticated initial evidence.

Lost context response after a committed callback becomes READY without extra browser; duplicate same-context delivery before/after contextStart does not emit a second bootstrap callback. Old callback plus newer allocation snapshot must not falsely certify delivery of those allocations.

Already-READY repeated plans calls before and after an action are harmless and never rematerialize, reset continuation or demand generation0 again. Direct proposals with accepted-but-incomplete bootstrap cannot send to provider. Stop/cancel/fence/source/context loss never recreates a browser or dispatch permit.

Late known usage inserted between entry reconciliation and reserve, between reserve and claim, and before repair blocks the actual next SDK HTTP call, commits counters/stop and charges once. Include under-ceiling late delta plus otherwise-overflowing next reservation, and terminal repeated reconciliation.

Hostile sanitized current-page NEXT_ACTION corpus cases use independently authored operation/target/input/predicate oracles and joined wrong-effect receipts. Controlled tests establish schema validity before semantic rejection; opt-in live credentials may remain UNAVAILABLE_NOT_RUN.
actualMissingSeamsToImplement: Durable bootstrap progress and scanner routing are absent in the inspected pre-fix SEC/REL paths; existing worker/context APIs are sufficient when used with the conditions above.

Current bootstrap callback does not carry materializationRevision; use backend snapshot/order plus same-context acknowledgement when prior bootstrap evidence predates the allocation snapshot. Do not invent that field or a second bootstrap callback.
Schema-pin validation currently occurs in model call reservation; bootstrap-only continuation needs the same check.
Current sourceSelections identifies bare referenceKind and must consume richer persisted meanings without losing accepted selections.
excludedScope: No publication/lowering/ready revision requirements from OBS-006.
No production account adapter work from OBS-007.
No live-provider benchmark or human pilot demands from OBS-009/010.
No model privacy policy change; approved deliberately authored nonsecret source remains allowed and resolved/account/runtime values remain excluded.
